# Hong Leong Bank Malaysia

> > Hong Leong Bank Malaysia (HLB) is a leading digital bank offering comprehensive personal and business banking services through HLB Connect and mobile platforms.

Hong Leong Bank Malaysia provides a full suite of financial services including personal banking, credit cards, loans, Islamic financing products like ASB Financing-i, and merchant solutions. The bank emphasizes digital banking innovation through its HLB Connect online platform and HLB Pocket Connect mobile app, alongside traditional banking services.

## Core Banking Services

- [Hong Leong Bank Malaysia Homepage](https://www.hlb.com.my): Main homepage featuring personal banking services, digital banking solutions, and HLB Connect platform access
- [Hong Leong Bank Main Site](https://hlb.com.my/): Primary website entry point for HLB Connect online banking and comprehensive personal banking products

## Business & Merchant Services

- [mPOS Merchant Portal Login](https://mposmerchant.hlb.com.my/): Secure login portal for Hong Leong Bank mPOS merchant users to manage payment processing and business transactions
